title: Effect of Writing One
statement: Let $W\in\mathbb{N}$, let $m:\mathbb{Z}\to\{0,1\}^W$ be a memory, and let $i\in\mathbb{Z}$. Executing the instruction that writes one at address $i$ changes the memory to the function obtained by updating address $i$ with the $W$-bit encoding of $1$.
